# PHT3D reference decks

Input files from decks PHT3D has actually run, kept as the specification our
writers are checked against. A format question is settled by what is here
rather than by what a manual says, because these are what the program accepted.

`ex1` is the Engesgaard and Kipp calcite–dolomite column, taken from the
mf6rtm benchmark suite (`benchmark/ex1/pht3d`, BSD-3-Clause, the same licence as
this project). Only the input files are kept; the outputs and binaries are not.

These are data, not code. Nothing here is imported or executed.
